donor_steps: clone ray at source_commit into a PX-rooted donor directory
clone RayPlatform at sibling_source_commit into donor/RayPlatform
verify both git HEADs before compiling
make -j2 with the pinned Debian bookworm g++/make toolchain; capture build log and ELF SHA-256
write only the understood ELF and log into the metered PX project root
image_steps: single-layer FROM the frozen parent image
install the pinned Debian MPI runtime (mpiexec, libopenmpi) in the same guarded build job
COPY the attested Ray ELF and the two adapter files; verify SHA-256 in-image
no reference, truth, panel or evaluator input in argv or environment
root_cause: The pinned ray revision treats RayPlatform as a sibling source tree; without it the compile fails on missing RayPlatform/store/CarriageableItem.h and CMake reports no sources.
